sources.title: Independent binary-outcome expected-loss derivation
sources.details: For success probability p, zero success loss, failure loss L, and path extra cost c in the same arbitrary point scale, E(loss)=p*0+(1-p)*L+c. Thus direct=.1*10=1; tool=.01*10+.02=.12; direct at .999=.001*10=.01. TOOL iff (p_tool-p_direct)*L>c; for the stated numbers p_direct<.988. See inspection.md and bounded Decimal calculation.
